properties.why: A tree on the lawn of the Rose Kennedy Greenway's northern end that is in neither the city inventory nor OpenStreetMap (audit cell c_4_3, pixel 89,188): an isolated, dense, round crown 7.9 m across in the USGS NAIP photograph of 7 July 2023 (the audit's proposed crown C2, checked by eye), standing alone on the lawn with no tree in the data under it. The MassGIS 15 cm leaf-off photograph of spring 2023 shows a bare, spreading, branched crown at the same place, so it is a broadleaved deciduous tree. Species is not clear from above; height is left to the pipeline's estimate from the crown width.
